defaults.motion_elements: the thousands of lights and the falling snow

shots.subject: A long walk-through tunnel of warm white lights arching over a snowy park path, thousands of tiny bulbs on curved frames, the snow on the path glowing gold
A dark park lake dotted with hundreds of glowing floating light spheres, their reflections trembling on the water, snowy willows and lit trees along the shore
shots.motion_elements: the floating light spheres, their reflections and the falling snow
shots.ambient: The light spheres bob gently on the water. Snow falls.

shots.subject: An avenue of huge old bare trees wrapped from trunk to fingertip in warm lights, a snowy path running straight between them into the distance
shots.focus: the far end of the avenue

shots.subject: Seen from a stone terrace high above, a snowy formal garden at night laid out in glowing patterns: ornate gold lace-like light arches along its paths, lit topiary cones and a softly lit pavilion at the centre, falling snow
Curtains of warm light strands hanging down from the branches of huge old oaks over a snowy lawn, glowing like falling rain
A garden of big glowing silk lanterns shaped like stars, crescent moons and snowflakes standing on the snowy lawn beside a still pond
shots.motion_elements: the glowing lanterns, their reflections in the pond and the falling snow

shots.subject: A giant cone-shaped Christmas tree made entirely of lights in a park clearing, a big glowing star on top and lit paths radiating out across the snow
shots.focus: the star on top of the light tree

shots.subject: A rolling snowy meadow filled with thousands of small glowing light stems like a field of stars, a line of lit trees along the horizon
An ice-blue tunnel of hanging snowflake-shaped lights in white and pale blue over a snowy path, the snow glowing cool silver
shots.focus: the end of the snowflake tunnel

shots.subject: A frozen ornamental fountain in a formal winter garden wrapped in warm lights, rows of lit topiary cones around it and a lit balustrade behind
An old stone footbridge in a park outlined in warm lights, floating lanterns on the dark river below and trees glowing on both banks
shots.motion_elements: the bridge lights, the floating lanterns and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. The floating lanterns drift slowly on the river.

shots.subject: A Victorian glasshouse in a botanic garden glowing gold from inside, its outline traced in lights, lit paths and light-wrapped trees leading to it across the snow
A path under red and white striped light arches with green-lit shrubs on both sides and giant glowing gift-box light sculptures standing on the snowy lawn
Huge chandeliers made of lights hanging from tall trees over a snowy forest path, glowing crystals catching the light
A lakeside promenade lined with giant glowing light sculptures of baubles and stars, their reflections stretching across the still black water, snowy hills behind
shots.motion_elements: the light sculptures, their reflections on the lake and the falling snow

shots.subject: A close view inside a tunnel of lights, individual warm bulbs crisp in the foreground and the long glowing corridor melting into golden bokeh
shots.motion_elements: the bulbs and the golden bokeh

shots.subject: An aerial view of a park festival at night, paths traced in warm lights winding through snowy woods, glowing arches and a big light tree at the centre
shots.focus: the glowing tree at the centre

shots.subject: A hedge maze in a snowy park, its paths lined with glowing ground lights, warm string lights along the hedge tops and a lit gazebo at the centre
A walkway of tall white-gold light pillars joined by garlands of glowing stars under snow-laden pine trees
The festival at blue hour, a long line of glowing light trees along a snowy lakeshore under a deep blue sky, their reflections in the calm water
